title: Artemis III crew: Bresnik commands, Parmitano flies as pilot
body: NASA named the four astronauts for the 2027 docking rehearsal in low Earth orbit. The landing slips to Artemis IV.

title: SpaceX is public: what it changes for Artemis
body: An IPO, a $20B bond, and a 35% pullback in two weeks. The Artemis lander program now lives inside a public-market story.
